detail.body:
## Motivation

Refs #37519 

T-HEAD SAIL exposes a CUDA-compatible torch backend (`SailSRTPlatform` already exists in `platforms/sail.py`), but its attention kernels are not the ones `sgl_kernel` ships:

- `sgl_kernel` imports its compiled `flash_ops` (FA3) at import time, so the import fails on SAIL.
- SAIL provides its own FA3 interface (`flash_attn_interface`) and FlashMLA library, with different metadata semantics: a lazily-initialized scheduler-metadata object, a 320 `sm_parts` cap, and no `qv` / `only_qv` support.
- The FA3 backend's capability assert rejects MLA on SM 8.x, which is the capability SAIL reports.
- Channel-wise FP8 `kv_b_proj` weights go through `channel_quant_to_tensor_quant` + FP8 BMM, which SAIL does not support.

This PR lets MLA models (DeepSeek / GLM family) run on SAIL with `--attention-backend fa3` and `flashmla`, including MTP / EAGLE speculative decoding and CUDA graph. It keeps the existing backends unchanged: SAIL-specific behavior is injected via `@plugin_hook` and only loaded when SAIL hardware is detected.

## Modifications

### New: `python/sglang/srt/hardware_backend/sail/attention/`

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `flash_attention.py` | Wraps SAIL's `flash_attn_interface`: `flash_attn_with_kvcache`, `flash_attn_varlen_func`, `get_scheduler_metadata`, with the same signatures as `sgl_kernel.flash_attn`. FA4 (`ver=4`) and `only_qv=True` raise `NotImplementedError` with a clear message. |
| `flash_mla.py` | Wraps SAIL's FlashMLA library: `get_mla_metadata`, `flash_mla_with_kvcache`, `flash_mla_sparse_fwd`. |
| `sail_fa3_hooks.py` | Hooks `flashattention_backend.flash_attn_varlen_func` / `flash_attn_with_kvcache` (REPLACE) and `FlashAttentionBackend.__init__` (AROUND), so the FA3 backend calls the SAIL ops. |
| `sail_flashmla_hooks.py` | Hooks for `sgl_kernel.flash_mla.*` (REPLACE) and `FlashMLABackend`: caps the CUDA graph metadata buffer at 320 `sm_parts`, and replaces `_apply_decode_target_verify_metadata` (SAIL metadata object, DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 seq_lens) and `init_forward_metadata_in_graph`, so lazy metadata init runs inside graph capture. |
| `sail_dsa_hooks.py` | Hooks for `DSAFlashMLAMetadata.copy_` / `.slice` and `DeepseekSparseAttnBackend` graph-metadata init/replay, so the cached SAIL metadata is never overwritten during replay. |

### Platform detection and hook loading

- `platforms/sail.py`: adds `is_sail_available()` (cached; true when the CUDA device name contains `ZW`). When it returns true, imports the three hook modules to register them. They are applied by the existing `load_plugins()` → `HookRegistry.apply_hooks()` path.
- `runtime_context.py`: adds `"is_sail"` to `_PLATFORM_PROBES`, so `get_platform().is_sail` is available.
- `sgl_kernel/utils.py`: adds `is_sail()`. `sgl_kernel/flash_attn.py`: skips the `flash_ops` import on SAIL, so `import sgl_kernel.flash_attn` no longer fails there.

### Attention backend / model changes

- `attention_registry.py`: the FA3 capability assert also accepts `major == 8` with MLA when `_is_sail`.
- `flashmla_backend.py`: `forward_decode` / `forward_extend` accept optional `q_rope` / `k_rope`.
  - When `k_rope` is given, the KV cache is written with `set_mla_kv_buffer`.
  - When `q_rope` is given, the backend builds the 576-dim query with `concat_mla_absorb_q_general`.
  - The `ForwardMode.EXTEND` branch forwards them to `FlashInferMLAAttnBackend.forward_extend`.
- `deepseek_common/utils.py`: adds `"flashmla"` to `FORWARD_ABSORB_CORE_ATTENTION_BACKENDS`, so the model passes `q_rope` / `k_rope` separately and does not pre-concatenate. Adds `_is_sail`.
- `forward_mla.py`:
  - Uses `concat_mla_absorb_q_general` in place of `torch.cat` for the non-absorb-core `q` / `k` concat.
  - On SAIL, skips the FP8 `w_kc` / `w_vc` BMM branches; the weights are BF16 there (see below).
- `deepseek_weight_loader.py`: on SAIL, dequantizes channel-wise FP8 `kv_b_proj` to BF16 (`w * weight_scale`) instead of `channel_quant_to_tensor_quant`.

- `python/pyproject_other.toml`: adds `flash-attention-for-sail`, `flashinfer-for-sail` and `flashmla-for-sail` to `srt_sail` (no version pins).

- `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py`: requires `get_device_sm() >= 89` before selecting the FlashInfer biased grouped topk kernel.

### Server-arg resolution

- `model_override_base.py`: on SAIL, MHA models default to `fa3`, under the same `is_no_spec_infer_or_topk_one` condition as Hopper.
- `model_hook.py`: on SAIL with an MLA backend, sets the prefill phase of `cuda_graph_config` to `DISABLED`. A captured prefill graph pins MLA to the absorbed path, which passes `qv` to FA3, and the SAIL FA3 interface rejects `qv`.

### Impact on non-SAIL platforms

- All `_is_sail` / `is_sail()` / `get_platform().is_sail` branches are false on non-SAIL devices, and no hook module is imported.
- **One shared behavior change:** with `"flashmla"` in `FORWARD_ABSORB_CORE_ATTENTION_BACKENDS`, CUDA FlashMLA now receives `q_rope` / `k_rope` and does the concat and `set_mla_kv_buffer` inside the backend. This replaces the concat in the model plus `set_kv_buffer`. It needs CUDA (Hopper) validation before going upstream.

### Known limitations

- SAIL FA3 does not support `qv` / `only_qv`. DSA + `fa3` (`DeepseekSparseAttnBackend._forward_fa3` always passes `qv`) is therefore not usable on SAIL; use `flashmla_kv` for DSA decode.
- Prefill CUDA graph is disabled for MLA on SAIL (see above).

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- TODO: fill in before merge -->

- [ ] SAIL: DeepSeek-V3 / GLM-5.x, `--attention-backend fa3` and `flashmla`, GSM8K
- [ ] SAIL: MTP / EAGLE (`speculative_attention_mode` prefill & decode), GSM8K + accept length
- [ ] CUDA (H100/H200): `--attention-backend flashmla`, DeepSeek-V3, GSM8K (regression check for the `FORWARD_ABSORB_CORE_ATTENTION_BACKENDS` change)

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- TODO: fill in before merge -->

- [ ] SAIL: `bench_serving` / `bench_one_batch` for fa3 and flashmla
- [ ] CUDA: `--attention-backend flashmla` decode throughput, no regression vs. base

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.sail.attention.flash_mla import (
+    flash_mla_sparse_fwd,
+    flash_mla_with_kvcache,
+    get_mla_metadata,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.dsa_backend_mtp_precompute import (
+    PrecomputedMetadata,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa_backend import (
+    DeepseekSparseAttnBackend,
+    DeepseekSparseAttnMultiStepBackend,
+    DSAFlashMLAMetadata,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch, ForwardMode
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.model_runner import ModelRunner
+
+
+class SailDSAFlashMLAMetadata(DSAFlashMLAMetadata):
+    """FlashMLA metadata produced by the SAIL FlashMLA build.
+
+    ``flashmla_metadata`` is a scheduler metadata object that the kernel fills
+    in lazily on its first call, so there is nothing to slice or copy into the
+    CUDA graph buffers.
+    """
+
+    def slice(self, sli):
+        return SailDSAFlashMLAMetadata(
+            flashmla_metadata=self.flashmla_metadata,
+            num_splits=self.num_splits,
+        )
+
+    def copy_(self, other: DSAFlashMLAMetadata):
+        return
+
+
+class SailDeepseekSparseAttnBackend(DeepseekSparseAttnBackend):
+    """DSA backend running on the SAIL FlashMLA build."""
+
+    def _call_flash_mla_sparse_fwd(self, **kwargs):
+        return flash_mla_sparse_fwd(**kwargs)
+
+    def _call_flash_mla_with_kvcache(self, **kwargs):
+        return flash_mla_with_kvcache(**kwargs)
+
+    def _call_get_mla_metadata(self, **kwargs):
+        return get_mla_metadata(**kwargs)
+
+    def _compute_flashmla_metadata(self, cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor, seq_len_q: int):
+        metadata = super()._compute_flashmla_metadata(cache_seqlens, seq_len_q)
+        return SailDSAFlashMLAMetadata(
+            flashmla_metadata=metadata.flashmla_metadata,
+            num_splits=metadata.num_splits,
+        )
+
+    def _precompute_replay_metadata(
+        self,
+        bs: int,
+        req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+        seq_lens_cpu: torch.Tensor,

+    _flashmla = None
+    _import_error = _e
+
+_IMPORT_ERROR = ImportError(
+    "Failed to import flash_mla for SAIL. "
+    "Ensure the flash_mla package is installed in your SAIL environment."
+)
+
+
+def get_mla_metadata(
+    cache_seqlens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    num_q_tokens_per_head_k: Optional[int] = None,
+    num_heads_k: Optional[int] = None,
+    num_heads_q: Optional[int] = None,
+    is_fp8_kvcache: bool = False,
+    topk: Optional[int] = None,

+

+

+    """
+    if _import_error is not None:
+        raise _IMPORT_ERROR from _import_error
+
+    if cache_seqlens is None:
+        return FlashMLASchedMeta(), None
+
+    assert num_q_tokens_per_head_k is not None
+    assert num_heads_k is not None
+
+    if is_fp8_kvcache and topk is None:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "FlashMLA dense FP8 get_mla_metadata is not supported on SAIL."
+        )
+
+    return _flashmla.get_mla_metadata(
+        cache_seqlens,
+        num_q_tokens_per_head_k,
+        num_heads_k,
+        num_heads_q=num_heads_q,

Appending "flashmla" to FORWARD_ABSORB_CORE_ATTENTION_BACKENDS changes which branch of forward_absorb_core() executes on SAIL. Previously, FlashMLA used the branch that concatenates the query components and applies:
```python
if llama_4_scaling is not None:    q *= llama_4_scaling
```
The new split-input branch bypasses that multiplication. It only forwards llama_4_scaling when _fuse_rope_for_trtllm_mla() is true, and that predicate excludes FlashMLA. The SAIL backend subsequently concatenates q and q_rope without applying the multiplier. [Model dispatch and scaling](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/30df2e680c07aa5de518113f670238d1a2013e84/python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_common/attention_forward_methods/forward_mla.py#L727-L799), [fusion predicate](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/30df2e680c07aa5de518113f670238d1a2013e84/python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_common/attention_forward_methods/forward_mla.py#L979-L987), [SAIL concatenation](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/30df2e680c07aa5de518113f670238d1a2013e84/python/sglang/srt/hardware_backend/sail/attention/flashmla_backend.py#L153-L158)
Impact: this produces incorrect attention scores for models using that scaling, specifically Mistral-Large-3, once positions reach the original context threshold and the multiplier differs from one. The model explicitly computes and passes this multiplier. Short-context sanity tests will not expose its loss. [Model scaling setup](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/30df2e680c07aa5de518113f670238d1a2013e84/python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_v2.py#L3163-L3173), [scaling formula](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/30df2e680c07aa5de518113f670238d1a2013e84/python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_common/utils.py#L180-L186)

Suggested fix: apply the multiplier to both query components before split-input dispatch, or pass it explicitly to the SAIL backend and apply it after concatenation. Add a regression case with a non-unit multiplier.
